Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives. 

  
 Infrastructure Engineer – NGS (Next‑Generation Sequencing) Operations 
 Durham, NC Hybrid: 3 days onsite / 2 days remote 
 The Infrastructure Engineer will support Next‑Generation Sequencing (NGS) instrumentation and high‑throughput genetic data processing operations. This role combines Linux server administration, AWS cloud engineering, distributed computing, and medical device system configuration. Candidates will apply strong IT infrastructure fundamentals while receiving extensive training in NGS workflows, sequencing instrumentation, and advanced cloud‑based pipeline orchestration.
 Job Responsibilities 
 Administer Linux servers supporting NGS instrumentation and genetic data processing workflows

 Build and manage AWS cloud infrastructure, including serverless orchestration for sequencing pipelines

 Configure and support NGS medical device instrumentation systems

 Work with grid computing and HPC environments for distributed data processing

 Develop automation scripts and tools using Python, Bash, and PowerShell, leveraging AI tools to streamline operations

 Orchestrate data processing pipelines from raw sequencing data through final readable results

 Collaborate with vendors on system integration, troubleshooting, and new technology implementations

 Support internal customers with technical guidance and solutions

 Learn and adapt to rapidly evolving NGS technologies, cloud platforms, and vendor systems

 Participate in off‑schedule maintenance windows and support activities

 Engage in regular collaboration with instrumentation and technology vendors

 Minimum Qualifications 
 3 or more years of experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, network operations, or cloud platform support

 2 or more years of experience using a scripting language such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell

 1 or more years of experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency

 3 or more years of experience supporting and troubleshooting enterprise systems or network infrastructure

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Cybersecurity/Information Security, Cloud Computing/Cloud Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering

 1 or more years of experience working with AWS cloud services

 1 or more years of experience in Linux server administration

 1 or more years of experience with Windows environments and PowerShell scripting

 1 or more years of experience with grid computing, HPC clusters, or distributed computing systems

 1 or more years of experience supporting NGS instrumentation, NGS medical devices, or laboratory instrumentation

 1 or more years of experience in automation or scripting

 Additional Job Standards 
 Flexibility to work off‑schedule hours when required

 Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate work, including writing scripts, troubleshooting issues, or learning unfamiliar systems

 Passion for learning new technologies

 Ability to learn quickly and solve problems independently

 Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non‑technical internal customers

 
 Pay Range: $70,000-$120,000  
 All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data
 
 Benefits:  Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan. Employees who are regularly scheduled to work a 7 on/7 off schedule are eligible to receive all the foregoing benefits except PTO or FTO.
